latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of “Video Generator Cartoon for Beginners — Create Cartoon Videos with AI”.

- Easily create animated cartoon videos from your text or images with no animation software required.
- Simple, beginner-friendly workflow: upload files, describe your video idea, and download a 1080p MP4.
- Automatic backend setup with free anonymous authentication—no account needed for first-time use.
- Supports input in JPG, PNG, MP4, GIF formats (up to 200MB); export in common video and image/audio formats.
- Cloud-based render pipeline ensures quick turnaround (1–2 minutes for a 30-second video).
- Session management, export workflow, and error handling designed for a smooth experience for new creators.
